# Clipper2 provenance pin

- Upstream: https://github.com/PolyClipping/Clipper2
- Commit: `b496b454df168a2280354857c1cd90bd6fa7b4dd`
- Commit date: 2026-10-30
- Declared library version in `clipper.version.h`: `2.0.1`
- License: Boost Software License 1.0 (see `LICENSE`; upstream
  `CPP/Clipper2Lib` headers and sources carry the BSL notice)
- Import method: `git clone --filter=blob:none` then `git checkout` of the exact
  commit, followed by copying only the files listed below. No binary, package
  manager, CMake, Xcode framework or prebuilt library was downloaded or used.
- Local changes to upstream files: **none**. The C ABI files under
  `Sources/Clipper2C` are project-authored adapters and are not upstream
  Clipper2 sources.

## Project-authored C ABI files (SHA-256)


## Why these files only

`clipper.engine.cpp` and `clipper.offset.cpp` implement the boolean clipping
and offset operations used by the qualification adapter. `clipper.engine.cpp`
includes `clipper2/clipper.h`, so the public headers it references are retained
to keep the upstream translation units byte-identical. No example SVG, sample,
CMake project, test, triangulation implementation, rect-clip implementation,
C# binding or prebuilt binary is vendored. Unused declarations in the retained
headers do not link into the product unless called.
